intro: Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay brews batches of Fool's Stout for travelers looking to return to the Shimmering Flats raceway. To concoct another serving, he requires twelve flasks of Zanzil's mixture.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you want some Fool's Stout, eh? Thinking of heading back to the races...?
All right, bring me more of Zanzil's mixture and I'll make some more stout for you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have those Zanzil mixtures yet, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, very good! Here is your pay.
And here is a little something extra... For your discretion.

related.n: Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout
